overview: You walked out alone and spoke the first words. The line was "Two housholds both alike in dignitie". The yard had been full since one. Mistress Ansell was in the lower gallery in her church hat, with Alse beside her. She had never been inside a playhouse.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Spoke the opening and stayed in the part.

parties.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
parties.context: Sat upright in the church hat.

key_provisions.text: the church hat in the gallery
